caption: This drawing features three detailed pencil sketches of a single object from different perspectives on an off-white or beige sheet of paper. The object, composed of an oval form with a patterned or ridged border and internal crossbars, is depicted in a top view at the top center of the image. Below, on the left, there is a sketch of the object’s underside or reverse side, while to the right of this, a side view illustration reveals the depth and curved profile of the object. The drawings are all rendered in varying degrees of gray pencil, and the label "ACTUAL SIZE" is faintly written in capital letters underneath the center drawings. The paper has some discoloration in the lower left corner and faint pencil markings or smudges throughout.
title: Knee Buckle
